long_biography.plain_text:
Hyde Park began with Rolewicz's idea of individually owned, climate-controlled storage suites for boats, recreational vehicles and small businesses. The project followed work managing housing construction in Charlotte and became one element of a broader development practice. Around Lake Norman he moved between custom homes, commercial space and Watermark, a condominium scheme whose construction he oversaw. Those projects placed land selection, building and property management within the same business.

Legacy Pointe Properties has since concentrated on self-storage facilities across the Carolinas. Rolewicz remains its founder and managing partner, with the company taking projects from land acquisition and zoning through construction and operation. Its facilities include properties managed under the Extra Space brand, while his own work has continued to range beyond storage. In local planning matters he has personally represented the developer, making site selection and permission-seeking part of his continuing practice.
